scientific_integrity: The theorem treats Hermitian flux-threaded cycles, distinct from the integral adjacency Hamiltonians underlying the qualifying motivation. The exact proofs use Fourier diagonalization, a finite-time interference integral, a spectral-gap inequality, and a Duhamel estimate. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The mixing cutoff is sharply of inverse-detuning order for each fixed even cycle but its constants are not optimized; the scaling profile is antipodal only. Equivalent coverage through general spectral-perturbation results remains a residual literature risk.
title: Detuning bottleneck and sinc crossover for quantum mixing on half-flux even cycles
